common.name: Name
common.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Choose how you want to sign in.

demo.title: Demo account
demo.body: Try the app with this account:

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Choose how you want to sign up.
register.sentLink: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then log in.
register.linkExpires: The link expires in 24 hours. After you verify, an admin still needs to approve your account before you can use the app.

resend.newLinkIfNeeded: We sent a new link if your account needs one.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentLink: If {{email}} belongs to an account that can reset its password, we sent it a link. Open it to choose a new password.
forgot.linkExpires: The link expires in 30 minutes and works once. Check your spam folder if it doesn’t arrive.
forgot.resent: If the account can reset its password, a new link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After you save it, you will be logged out on every device.
reset.changedNotice: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidDescription: This reset link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Enter the email you signed up with and we will send a new verification link.
verify.invalidDescription: This verification link is invalid, expired or already used. Enter your email to get a new one.
verify.adminWillReview: An admin will review your account. You can log in to check its status.
verify.resent: If that account needs verifying, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.

confirmLink.invalidDescription: This link is invalid, expired or already used, or the request it was for has changed. Nothing was linked.
confirmLink.title: Confirm account link
confirmLink.description: A Telegram account asked to sign in to your account. If it was you, enter your account password to confirm. If not, close this page and nothing will change.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.description: Add your name and email. After you verify the email, an admin can approve your account.
completeProfile.sentLink: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address; this page moves on by itself.
completeProfile.nothingArriving: Nothing arriving? Use a different email, or contact an admin.
completeProfile.resent: If this email can be used, a new link is on its way.

awaiting.title: Awaiting approval
awaiting.description: Thanks, {{name}}. An admin needs to approve your account before you can use the app.

telegram.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
telegram.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again later.
telegram.stepOpenChat: Open the chat and press Start
telegram.stepEnterCode: Enter the 6-digit code we send you
telegram.sentCodeTo: We sent a code to {{handle}} in Telegram
telegram.signInHint: Sign in or create an account with Telegram. No password needed.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to press Start in Telegram…
telegram.pressStart: Press Start in Telegram, then come back here for your code.
telegram.qrLabel: QR code to open Telegram on your phone
telegram.orScan: Or scan with your phone camera.

notices.emailVerified: Email verified. Return to the app or log in.
notices.emailVerifiedLogIn: Your email is verified. You can now log in.
notices.telegramConnected: Telegram is now connected to your account. Log in with Telegram or your email.
